label: Enable SSH diagnostics
help: Off by default. Only an executed request connects; Prepare and opening this form never authenticate.

label: Approved hosts and profiles (JSON)
help: Array of host objects: id, hostname, port, username, host_key_sha256, auth, credential_ref or agent_key_sha256, commands, paths and services. Profiles: system, uptime, memory, disk, processes, service, journal. See the package README for complete examples; never paste private keys here.

label: Total request deadline (s)
help: Covers connection, authentication and the remote command. Stop closes the local connection; remote process termination cannot be guaranteed.

label: Maximum bytes per output
help: If stdout or stderr exceeds this cap, both partial outputs are discarded before publication.

label: Mask email addresses
help: Known credentials and credential-like lines are always masked. Pattern matching is not a guarantee of universal anonymization.

label: Connection / authentication deadline (s)
help: Per-stage cap within the total deadline. No automatic retries.

label: Authorized SSH agent socket
help: Only used by hosts with auth=agent and an exact agent_key_sha256. Empty uses SSH_AUTH_SOCK from the runtime environment; no agent forwarding or implicit key search.

label: Additional secrets to mask
help: Up to eight wallet references containing literal text to redact from both outputs. A locked or missing secret refuses the request before connecting.
